title: Is It True? And What Is AI?
subject: digital

sections.body: Not everything online is true. Anyone can post anything!
Ask: Who made this? Does it sound too amazing? Can a grown-up check it in a trusted place?
AI helpers, like Hoot, are computer programs, not people. They don't have feelings, and they can make mistakes.
If an AI says something that seems wrong or upsetting, tell a grown-up.
Look at a silly fake photo online together and talk about how you can tell it's not real.

quiz.q: A video says 'Cats can fly!' What should you do?
options: Check with a grown-up or a trusted source
hints: Does it sound too amazing to be true?
If someone said 'Fish can climb trees!', you'd check before believing. Do the same here.
quiz.explain: Check with a grown-up or trusted source. Not everything online is true!

quiz.q: What is an AI helper like Hoot?
options: A computer program that can make mistakes
hints: A calculator is a machine that helps with sums. An AI is a program that helps with words.
quiz.explain: Hoot is a computer program, not a person, and it can make mistakes.

quiz.q: Does an AI helper like Hoot have feelings?
options: No, it is a computer program
Only when you are kind to it
hints: Think about what Hoot really is.
Hoot runs on a computer. Is it alive?
A puppy is alive. It can feel happy or scared. Is Hoot alive like a puppy?
quiz.explain: Hoot is a computer program, not a person. It has no feelings, and it can make mistakes.
